Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 3-1 at 1416 N. Maplewood
                              Ave ~ amend

                                      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks, and Building Standards
                                                                              April 19, 2023
                                                                       City Council Meeting


                                      ORDINANCE

           BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO;

         SECTION 1. Ordinance 2023-920, proposing Application 22094-T1, shall be rescinded
in its entirety.

       SECTION 2. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all the current B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District symbols
and indications as shown on Map No. 3-1 in the area bounded by:

       a line 175.0 north of and parallel to West Hirsch Street; North Maplewood Avenue; a line
       150.0 north of and parallel to West Hirsch Street; and the public alley next west of and
       parallel to North Maplewood Avenue

to those of a RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

      SECTION 3. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.




                                                                               Daniehla Spa|
                                                                            Alderman, 1®' Ward
